{{Top|leg}}
A '''light pressure suit''' was a type of [[Pressure suit/Legends|pressure suit]] used by members of the [[Skakoan/Legends|Skakoan]] [[Species/Legends|species]] when traveling away from their [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Skako/Legends|Skako]]. The suit was similar to an [[armored flight suit]], although it was much bulkier due to the [[Pressure regulator/Legends|pressurizers]] and [[Breath mask/Legends|breathing equipment]] needed for the Skakoans to survive in a standard [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]]. The light pressure suit was the most common type of pressure suit used by the species.<ref name="PH:S">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/PHSkako|series=Planet Hoppers|text=Skako}}</ref>
